description: Header file defining a lightweight CUDA context interface for ATen, including function declarations for device properties, handles, and workspace management, with conditional includes for various CUDA and ROCm components.

classes.name: WorkspaceMapWithMutex
classes.description: Structure holding a map from stream handles to workspaces with thread-safe access.

methods.name: getNumGPUs
methods.description: Returns the number of available GPUs (deprecated, use device_count() instead).

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Checks if CUDA is available with at least one device.
